title: Montauk experiments behind Stranger Things

tellings.quote: I think even the makers of Stranger Things say that uh it's based off of, you know, the Montauk experiments and I I think it's pretty well established that there were some experiments in Montauk, Long Island.

plain: Secret experiments are said to have taken place at Montauk, on Long Island, New York, and the TV series Stranger Things is said to be based on them. Michels says this himself: he thinks the makers of the show have said as much, and that it is "pretty well established" that some experiments happened there, though he does not say what they were or where he learned it.
